title: Artifact Knowledge Graph — Data Map
summary: Type-level map of leafcutter-ai's artifact nodes and the fields that connect them. Each edge carries the field that encodes it plus a two-axis trust rating (enforcement x shape). This is the static schema of the knowledge graph; the dynamic Atlas view will later render live instances against these same edge types.

enforcement.enforced: A pre-commit hook and/or required CI gate blocks violations.
enforcement.derived-validated: Machine-generated AND its freshness/parity is blocked at commit.

shape.clean: Single unambiguous value form; ingestable as-is.
shape.ambiguous: One field multiplexes several edge types; must be partitioned.
shape.often-empty: Frequently blank in the live store.

legend.ingestable_rule: A link is ingestable as-is only when enforcement is 'enforced' or 'derived-validated' AND shape is 'clean'.

groups.ac-core: AC lifecycle: criteria, tickets, tests, code
